def update_confidence(confidence_path: Path, new_confidence: float, rationale: str) -> None:
    data = json.loads(confidence_path.read_text())
    data["current_confidence"] = new_confidence
    history = data.setdefault("history", [])
    history = [entry for entry in history if entry.get("analysis") != 1]
    history.append(
        {
            "analysis": 1,
            "confidence": new_confidence,
            "rationale": rationale,
        }
    )
    data["history"] = history
    confidence_path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")
